mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening economy, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS shows sustained growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a reduction in supply, which can lead to higher prices and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of instances where INDPRO falls by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and higher costs for businesses, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 200k & UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS and UNRATE meet the trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals disinflation, which leads to lower input costs for businesses and higher profit margins, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL falls by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 5% & UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where HOUST and UNRATE meet the trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 shows sustained growth.
